sources.title: FishSense Scout - Autonomous eyes for large-scale ocean monitoring
sources.snippet: FishSense Scout is the newest addition to the FishSense family and is currently under active development. Scout serves as the basis for an automated sensing platform intended for applications such as large-scale ocean monitoring, aquaculture, and other environments where a computer-controlled camera system can support repeatable data collection over extended periods.
